items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: This is Galbraith, Kenny Bryant, Willard Brown--I can't see the drummer, that's probably Ed Cornelius and is this Pruitt again? ... That's Carl Pruitt. ... I don't know, he was recommended to me ... I had to send him back. ... We played at a couple of the EVAC hospitals
